title: Wingbox evidence package manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of an evidence package: every member of the archive with its id, safe relative path, role, media type, length and SHA-256, the required members with the state of each, and what whoever packed stated. It holds neither its own digest nor a signature: a review names the SHA-256 of these bytes, and a detached attestation has the member name given under attestation.

bundle.description: The id of the bundle: the SHA-256 of the lines `<sha256>  <path>` of the members, by path, each ended by a line feed.

state.description: incomplete when a required member is not present as the record names it.

created.description: The time of the record (its `generated`); empty without a readable record. No clock is read when a package is built.

ref.description: The tag, branch or commit of the action that ran.

wingbox.description: The Wingbox release that built the graph.

checked.description: The commit whose files were analysed.

url.description: The address of the CI run, to check it there.

retention.description: How long the job keeps the package, in the job's own words; empty when it did not say.

control.description: The control the evidence is for. `mapping` is none and the other values are empty when no control mapping was given.

stated.description: Versions the job stated when it packed (build, model, prompt, tool-schema, test-data), by name.

commit.description: The commit the policy files are taken from: the commit checked.

read.description: Whether the files of that commit could be read when the package was built.

member.description: The id of the member that holds the file; empty when it is not present.

checks.description: Every required test and every test that uses what changed, with one outcome each and one per case.

id.description: The test as the record names it.

group.description: The group of the manifest of required tests; empty for a test that uses what changed.

members.description: Every member of the archive but this manifest, the reviews and an attestation, by path.

path.description: The name of the member in the archive: a safe relative path.

source.description: The name or path the bytes were read from: as the record names it, or from the root of the repository.

commit.description: For a policy file, the commit it was read from; else empty.

required.description: What a complete package holds, with the state of each.

absent.description: The ids of the required members that are not present.

statements.description: The three statements that stay apart: what the record states, what a review states, and what is stated nowhere.

attestation.description: The place of a detached attestation: the member name it takes and the member whose exact bytes it is made over. The tool that packs writes none.
